phrase: A government called AI's risks a hoax. Its own regulators are now checking if those risks already hurt people.
phraseAlternatives: A government dismissed AI's dangers as a hoax. Its own watchdog is now checking if that hoax already hurt people.
One official called AI risk a hoax. The agency meant to protect the public is now investigating that same risk.
A hoax, said one government about AI danger. A formal probe, said its own regulators, about that same danger.
AI's risks were called a hoax by officials. Investigators work down the hall, checking if the hoax left real damage.
alt: A proud official presses a HOAX stamp onto a warning sign on the left, while a worried official on the right points a magnifying glass at a cracked shield mounted on a plain building, with a dotted line linking the stamp to the shield across the top.

brief.concept: A government calls AI danger a hoax, while its own regulators quietly investigate whether that very danger already hurt people.
brief.metaphor: Denial and investigation side by side: a bold HOAX stamp sits right next to the cracked shield the regulators are inspecting.

cast.who: a government official pressing a large stamp marked HOAX onto a warning sign
a second official holding a magnifying glass up to a cracked security shield
a plain company building with the cracked shield mounted on its front

brief.composition: Blueprint-style technical scene on a grid. Left: a human official presses a large stamp reading HOAX over a yellow warning triangle. Right: a second human official holds a magnifying glass up to a cracked shield icon mounted on a plain building facade. A thin dotted line connects the HOAX stamp to the cracked shield, tying the denial to the inspection. One yellow highlight marks the crack in the shield as the visual punchline.
brief.alt: A government official presses a stamp reading HOAX onto a warning sign, while another official holds a magnifying glass up to a cracked security shield mounted on a plain company building, with a dotted line connecting the two scenes.
